title: Ghost Signal M03–M06 level design, environmental storytelling and technical art quality standard
summary: Research-derived mandatory pipeline: purpose and bubble diagram → navigable blockout → joined architecture → reserved interactive footprints → licensed art clusters → causal environmental storytelling → layer separation and full game viewport review → browser/Android tests → owner signoff. Critically reject pasted controls over doors, art/collision mismatches, unconnected conduits, arbitrary props, untested escort paths, and background/map version drift. Programs: M03 exterior survey/command/supply/ridge; M04 consistent rescue ruins/triage/escort; M05 generator–breaker–physical gate–transmitter; M06 compartmentalized five-door auxiliary bunker. Preserve M01/M02, engine, saves, UI, original Ghost Signal VFX, upgraded generator; no new missions. Source-based method only, not implementation or owner approval.
